text:
lina: hey all, day 2here. I merged the onboarding kubeconfig but when I switch to `redwood-dev` context I get `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "lina" cannot list resource "pods" in the namespace "payments-qa"`. Is there a quick path to view-only access for that namespace?

michael: welcome! :wave: two quick checks: `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n payments-qa`. paste outputs pls.

lina: current-context `redwood-dev`, `kubectl auth can-i` -> `no`.

dev-infra: likely your IdP group isn't mapped to the payments team's RoleBinding. Do you know the namespace owner? We require owner approval for granting longer access. Short-term we can create a temporary RoleBinding scoped to view.

lina: owner in the chart is `@anna` per the README.

anna: yup thatnamespace is ours. happy to approve view access for you. michael/dev-infra, please limit to `view` and set TTL 2h.

dev-infra: on it. Running: `kubectl create rolebinding onboard-lina-view --clusterrole=view --user=lina -n payments-qa` TTL 2h (audited). Ticket INF-7710 opened.

devex-bot: Audit: RoleBinding `onboard-lina-view` created by dev-infra; TTL 2h; INF-7710.

lina: I can list pods now, thank you!! :tada:

michael: for the permanent flow, please open an infra access request (k8s namespace access template) and include: namespace, justification, duration, owner (anna), CI needs, and repo names. Link: https://intra.redwood.com/infra-access-requests

anna: small note for you @lina: if you need deploy rights for a feature branch we prefer using a short-lived `team-qa` service account and adding you to the deployment approval in the CI. Ask the payments eng lead in the ticket.

lina: perfect, filing INF-7710 now and tagging #devex. thanks everyone!
